title: Mutlhandlami la Hlawuriweke
intro: Xifaniso xa malembe lama hundzeke xi yime xi lunghekele ku nghena ematin’wini. Loko ndlela yi vonaka yi nga ri erivaleni naswona ku kanakana ku hangalaka exikarhi ka vanhu, nandza loyi u hlawuriwile ku teka xiambalo xa nkongomiso. Hi ndzhwalo wa vurhumiwa byo kwetsima emakatleni ya vona, va ye emahlweni va rhangela laha van’wana a va kanakana ku landzela kona.
clues: Ndzi hlawuriwile ku famba na muprofeta naswona ndzi dyondze eka vutlhari bya vona
Ndzi yime emahlweni ka Areka loko xitshembiso xa Muhlayisi wa hina xi tshinela, kutani ndzi vona vanhu va sungula ku kanakana
Ndzi endliwe ndzi yima emakumu ka leswi tshembisiweke loko murhangeri wa hina a ri karhi a rila ni ku kombela eka Allah hikwalaho ka hina
Ndzi hlawuriwile ku yisa emahlweni vurhumiwa lebyi a byi nyikiwile un’wana emahlweni ka mina
Ndzi nyikiwe matimba ya Xikwembu yo kongomisa vanhu laha va yaka kona
Ndzi humelerile eku hetisiseni ka leswi sunguriweke emahlweni ka mina, naswona ndzi kume xitiyisekiso xa vanhu xa nkongomiso wa mina

arabic: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers." (5:21)
